feedbackMechanism.howToSendFeedback: Answer the Feedback Form at the City Assessor's Office frontline desk and drop it in the box, or hand it to the Officer of the Day. You can also call 742-6882 or 0966-812-0533.
feedbackMechanism.howFeedbackIsProcessed: The Administrative Division checks what the feedback is about within one working day and passes it to the division concerned. Once that division replies, the office contacts you by email, text or phone. Complaints go on the Complaint Form (CSC Form No. 3) or by email, and need your full name, address and contact details, an account of what happened, any evidence, and the name of the person being complained about. The Administrative Division reads complaints daily, coordinates with the division concerned, investigates where needed, then writes an Incident Report for the Legal Office. The Legal Office sends its findings to the City Mayor, copy to the City Assessor's Office, for final action.
